events.title: 💻 CODECRAFT – BUILD • CODE • SOLVE 🚀
events.description:
The Department of Information Technology, Faculty of Engineering and Technology, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, in association with CHAT Club, presents CODECRAFT, an exciting coding initiative exclusively for first-year IT students!

Get ready to sharpen your problem-solving skills, strengthen your programming fundamentals, and explore the world of coding through HackerRank. From arrays and strings to functions, control structures, and the conceptual basics of pointers and memory, CODECRAFT is all about thinking logically, coding efficiently, and solving problems with confidence.

Whether you're taking your first steps into programming or looking to challenge your logical thinking, it's time to turn your ideas into code and your potential into progress.

*Think Logically. Code Efficiently. Solve Better.*

Organised by CHAT Club

Convener: Dr. Rajeswari Mukesh, HOD / IT

Faculty Coordinators: Dr. B. Dwaraknath, Mr. R. Sudharshan & Dr. R. Deeptha

Event Student Coordinators: Joe Felix Arock J, Pharama Tharun S R & Poornima K

🔥 Your coding journey starts here. Let’s build, code, and solve!

announcements.title: MANDATORY: Odd Semester End-Term Examination Schedule Released
announcements.content: All B.Tech students across all departments are hereby notified that the final timetable for the upcoming semester examinations has been published. Hall tickets will be issued through the academic ERP portal starting Friday. Attendance minimum of 75% is strictly enforced.

announcements.title: CSE Department: Capstone Project Phase-1 Evaluation Schedule
announcements.content: All final year B.Tech CSE (all specializations) students must submit their Phase-1 GitHub repository link and preliminary documentation by 5:00 PM this Friday. Panel presentations commence next Monday in Lab 402.

announcements.title: Google Cloud Study Jams: Registrations Open for 2024 Batch
announcements.content: GDSC SRMIST Ramapuram invites 1st and 2nd year students to participate in the Google Cloud Study Jams. Complete 5 quest badges to receive official Google Developer swag and certificates.
